title: Score script: a max-turns stop keeps its graded score
context: FR-13/AC-8 say any with-arm run with error set counts as 0. The first full run showed routing cases that routed correctly, then hit max_turns while the agent kept working: the eval tool scored them 1.0, our script zeroed them (routing 0.55 vs 0.65). A turn limit reached after the graded outcome is not a failure. Change: a run whose only error is the max-turns stop keeps its grader score; crashes, timeouts and cost-cap cuts still count as 0. Also raise the CI cost caps to routing 20, firewall 25, receipt 30 (measured 12.85 / 15.63 / 17.69).
